NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author squashed the two commits into one and says they retook the before/after screenshots. The PR description now describes the back-to-back capture method.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Commit history is now a single coherent commit with a descriptive message. |
| ✅  | Before/after shots were taken in the same tab with the same viewport, scroll and crop, which matches the "precise screenshots" ask. |
| ℹ️  | The author says the clipping doesn't reproduce at DPR 1, so the shots show added spacing rather than a fixed cut-off emoji. The reviewer should judge whether that is enough. |
| ✅  | The linked issue has "help wanted" and is assigned to the author, and CI passed. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the feedback, was asked for the re-review, and has handled the earlier attempts at this issue.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.
